name: cryptoetf
description: Live spot crypto ETF flows for 13 assets, the CEFI sentiment index and spot prices.
long_description: Daily net flows for every US-listed spot crypto ETF complex — BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, HYPE, DOGE, LINK, AVAX, HBAR, LTC, BNB, DOT and SUI — plus the composite CEFI sentiment index and live coin prices. Figures are net USD millions taken from the issuers' own daily reports; for the eight smaller complexes, where no market-wide aggregator exists, they are computed from each issuer's fund pages. The extension is a zero-dependency stdio bridge to the hosted endpoint at mcp.cryptoetf.today — no API key and no account are required.

tools.name: get_flows_summary
tools.description: Latest-day net ETF inflow/outflow in USD millions for all 13 tracked assets.

tools.name: get_asset_flows
tools.description: Daily net ETF flow history for a single asset over the last 30 days.

tools.name: get_weekly_analytics
tools.description: 7-day aggregated flow analytics per asset: total, daily average, positive/negative day counts.

tools.name: get_cefi_index
tools.description: Composite CEFI sentiment score across all tracked assets (baseline 100).

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Current spot price and 24-hour change for every tracked asset.
